content.name: Sophie Krämer
content.title: Junior HR Generalist
content.summary: Business graduate specialising in HR (B.A., TH Köln) with 18 months as a working student and a first full-time HR role at a media services company. Handles contracts, onboarding and Personio administration for 380 employees and cut onboarding paperwork time per hire by half.

experience.title: Junior HR Generalist
bullets: Prepare employment contracts, amendments and reference letters (Arbeitszeugnisse) for 380 employees.
Moved onboarding documents into Personio workflows, halving paperwork time per new hire.
Prepare monthly payroll input for the external DATEV payroll provider and check working-time records.
Support the HR business partner in meetings with the works council and keep the minutes.

experience.title: Working Student, HR (Werkstudentin)
bullets: Supported recruiting for 30 vacancies, about 18 hours a week alongside my studies.
Scheduled interviews and sent around 900 applicant communications in line with GDPR retention rules.
Organised two onboarding days for apprentices and dual-study students.

education.details: Thesis: hybrid work agreements and works council co-determination; grade 1.7

courses.name: Arbeitsrecht für Personaler (employment law for HR practitioners)

achievements.title: Student council treasurer
achievements.detail: Managed the faculty student council budget, 2022 to 2023.
